headline: Everest Property (EVER) posts a 66.7% five‑day gain, the strongest mover across sectors
market_take: Property stocks dominate the multi‑day performance, with EVER up 66.7% over five days and several peers showing double‑digit gains. Today's trading is mixed: PF surged 25% on an open price gap, while AQUA and TPOLY posted sharp declines. Food sector saw XBIO jump 14.29% intraday alongside a SET clarification filing, and NRF added 8.33% on volume. Unusual volume spikes in PF&REIT (TIF1, QHOP, M‑PAT) highlight heightened short‑term activity.

sector_notes.note: XBIO (+14.29% intraday) triggered a SET clarification filing; AQUA opened down 9.09% on a price gap; NRF rose 8.33% on volume; F&D posted the largest 1‑day gain (+18.75%).

PF opened up 25% on a price gap; KUN (+14.81%) and NVD (+14.55%) showed strong volume‑adjusted moves; EVER surged 66.7% over five days despite a 9.09% dip today; CMC fell 8.51% today after a 22.9% five‑day rise and announced director changes.
TPOLY continued its decline with a -16.7% five‑day change and an 8.33% open price gap; SOLAR also opened down 8.33%; DEMCO posted a 7.95% intraday rise.
M‑PAT displayed extreme volatility with a 21.21% price gap, a 15.38% intraday rise and a 5.1σ volume spike; TIF1 and QHOP recorded volume spikes of 10.6σ and 17.6σ respectively.
